caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white pencil or ink on paper with a beige background. Central to the composition is a shaded, three-dimensional depiction of a round, deep bowl with a small, flat handle or knob at the top rim, giving it a symmetrical appearance. Around this main object, there are two additional technical sketches: one in the upper left shows a detailed, flat ornamental or structural pattern inside a rectangle; the other, in the lower right inside another rectangle, shows a side profile view of the same bowl with horizontal and vertical dimension lines and arrows, indicating its width and height. The drawing includes straight outlines for the placement of each element but no text except for some indecipherable inscription below the upper left design, and the entire layout is orderly and precise.
title: Pewter Porringer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
